high_resolution_authorization.scientific_scope: Internal Poissonnier 2026 open-arena painted-trail response development estimation for the frozen P2-v1 transient per-trial engagement mechanism only. This authorization permits one frozen high-resolution P2 response search after this authorization is merged to main and the permanent main test/deploy gate is green on a commit containing this exact authorization, estimator, and policy. It is not external validation, canonical locomotion promotion, Candidate B authorization, P1 rescue, or Y-maze validation.

authorized_frozen_execution.projected_no_lapse_rule: For each P2 Halton index 1..999, reuse the exact same sigma and kappa coordinates and force p_lapse=0. Add the same exact canonical null as index 1000. Rank the P2 and no-lapse panels separately on the same primary objective.
authorized_frozen_execution.primary_objective: Equal-weight arithmetic mean of the four squared pheromone-minus-DCM treatment-contrast errors: two primary observables x short/long path strata, with equal colony weighting.
authorized_frozen_execution.secondary_guard_rule: Post-selection only. On the independent final-check panel, absolute standardized P2 contrast error must be <= 1.0 for each of the four path x secondary-metric components.
authorized_frozen_execution.canonical_null_survival_guard: P2 selected candidate must beat exact canonical null in at least 5 of 6 held-out LOCO folds and have strictly positive median relative held-out improvement versus exact null.
authorized_frozen_execution.structural_increment_survival_guard: P2 selected candidate must beat the separately selected projected p_lapse=0 no-lapse benchmark in at least 5 of 6 held-out LOCO folds and have strictly positive median relative held-out improvement versus no-lapse.
authorized_frozen_execution.dual_survival_rule: Both heldout survival guards must pass. Failure of either closes P2-v1 response estimation without retuning.
authorized_frozen_execution.identifiability_rule: If dual survival passes: exact null must be outside the P2 near-best set; best all-data no-lapse benchmark must lie outside the same P2 near-best tolerance; selected normalized sigma, kappa, and p_lapse coordinates must each be at least 0.02 from an active bound; near-best normalized span must be <= 0.60 for each parameter.
authorized_frozen_execution.final_increment_rule: On the independent final-check panel, selected P2 primary loss must be strictly lower than both selected no-lapse benchmark primary loss and exact canonical-null primary loss.
authorized_frozen_execution.final_fit_rule: The all-102-row fit may occur only if both LOCO survival guards pass. It must reuse the same frozen candidate panels. The independent final-check panel may evaluate frozen promotion guards but may not trigger refitting, alternate candidates, or changed seeds.

execution_firewall: Do not change sigma, kappa, or p_lapse bounds/scales, Halton mapping, candidate counts, no-lapse comparator construction, trial counts, seeds, physics dt, objective construction, colony weighting, fold membership, secondary guards, identifiability thresholds, or promotion thresholds.
Do not add nuisance parameters or refit baseline locomotion, H2, H3, H4, or H5.

Do not use P2 engagement assignments, response RNG U/seed, sensor diagnostics, steering omega, moving speed, moving distance, straightness, moving-time fraction, raw headings, or any forbidden observable for candidate ranking.
Do not pool pheromone-minus-DCM contrasts across path strata or weight colonies by ant-row count.
Do not introduce treatment-specific, path-specific, colony-specific, direction-specific, experience-specific, or fold-specific response parameters.
Do not access, parse, or use P1 official response-estimation result semantics for tuning, selection, ranking, or interpretation of the P2 search.
Do not implement or combine Candidate B relative/Weber transduction.
Do not access or use Y-maze data, outcomes, simulations, geometry, labels, or metrics for selection, fitting, ranking, or interpretation.
Do not change the frozen P2 mechanism, runtime, model structure, response RNG namespace, P1 local-kernel component, apparatus, canonical runtime, or canonical locomotion model.
Do not run an adaptive second-stage search, inject candidates, alter bounds, increase the budget, change seeds, or rerun with favorable seeds after seeing target-ranked outcomes.
Do not pass --candidates, --trials, --eval-trials, --seed, --final-trials, --final-seed, or --dt in high-resolution mode.
high_resolution_authorization.official_execution_rule: Authorize exactly one official execution of the frozen high-resolution P2-v1 response-estimation procedure after this authorization is merged and effective on main and the permanent main test/deploy workflow succeeds on a main commit containing this exact authorization, estimator blob 38d66d28e94d2f532e9c8a20bd6553d6d11be8a6, policy blob eaa74df19f3fdc1a59dec5f0b3b2efefba3f89ce, and qualification-freeze blob 1d46b594cb154a93c2e321fb67d399acdd821993. A rerun is permitted only if the first official execution is formally declared invalid because of a genuine implementation or infrastructure error; the entire frozen procedure must then be rerun unchanged.
high_resolution_authorization.post_result_rule: Freeze and record the complete P2 result before any interpretation-driven code, policy, mechanism, or model change. Failure cannot be rescued by retuning P2-v1, changing the search, changing the no-lapse comparator, weakening either survival guard, or selecting a favorable rerun. If either dual survival guard fails, close P2-v1 response estimation. If dual survival passes but identifiability, final increment, or secondary guards fail, report the appropriate limited conclusion without promoting a fixed parameter triple.
high_resolution_authorization.response_target_semantic_access_scope: Only through the exact qualified estimator high-resolution code path after this authorization is effective on main. The authorization file itself and its review/audit may not parse the target rows.

authorization_gate_hardening.rule: Because effective_when_merged_to_main is true, the estimator and semantic response-target loader must reject high-resolution execution on this authorization review branch. High-resolution execution becomes eligible only when the exact authorization is present on main.
authorization_gate_hardening.reason: Prevents review-branch presence of the authorization file from making the official 102-row search executable before authorization review and merge.

high_resolution_authorization.post_merge_execution_precondition: Before the official P2 high-resolution search, verify the permanent main test/deploy workflow succeeds on the merged authorization commit. The official search must then be triggered by a separate one-shot main-only execution gate; this authorization PR must not itself run the high-resolution search.
high_resolution_authorization.post_merge_execution_precondition_reason: Separates authorization review from outcome generation and guarantees the target-ranked search begins from an exact green permanent main checkpoint.

search.method: deterministic 3D Halton low-discrepancy panel plus exact canonical null
